rules.description: GNOME: app-specific Ctrl+H history/replace and VS Code Ctrl+G/M
GNOME: iTerm2 tab selection/reordering, window close, search, zoom and F11
GNOME: Ctrl word navigation/deletion and document boundaries in GUI apps
GNOME: Ctrl+<key> acts as ⌘+<key> in GUI apps (terminals keep Ctrl)
GNOME: terminal Ctrl+Shift shortcuts (C/V copy-paste, T/W tab, N window, F find)
GNOME: Ctrl+Click -> Cmd+Click (open link in new tab; right-click via real mouse button)
GNOME: Alt+Tab app switch, Alt+` cycles same-app windows
GNOME: left Super window tiling, maximize/restore, workspaces, minimize and lock
GNOME: tap left Super for overview; hold Command without a lazy delay
GNOME: Print opens screenshot UI; Shift+Print captures screen; Alt+Print selects window
